up: Retrieve all activity records for assay CHEMBL4649944, returning the following columns: the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the activity ID, the exact activity value (standard_value), the units (standard_units), the relation (standard_relation), and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Return all rows for this assay.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.activity_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649944';
